entries.name: empty-and-equal-collections
entries.result: The prescribed 100-message private-use candidate measures 35-byte warm and 75-byte cold transactions and passes 64/128-byte ceilings.
pending: The candidate has no experimental registry allocation and the complete mandatory V01 state/bundle evidence remains incomplete.

entries.name: known-checkpoint-incremental-delta
entries.result: Only entries after the known checkpoint are offered in deterministic sequence order.

entries.name: unknown-checkpoint-bounded-full-fallback
entries.result: Unknown checkpoints fall back to deterministic bounded full pages with durable cursors.

entries.name: compressibility-extremes
implemented_evidence: prototype benchmark compressible and incompressible fixtures
pending: An approved codec allocation and a legal B2F/LZHUF oracle are unavailable; no normative encoded-byte expectations can be published.

entries.name: representation-and-operation-boundaries

entries.name: interruption-and-restart-matrix
pending: The specification does not state whether the required matrix is a Cartesian product of prefix points, endpoint restart modes, and storage boundaries; the current harness covers every axis but not every cross-product cell.

entries.name: authorized-source-and-carrier-change
entries.result: An identical representation resumes through a different application-authorized source and carrier.

entries.name: duplicate-and-replay-idempotency
pending: Publish a complete duplicate-offer and lost-final-receipt trace with normative state assertions.

entries.name: malformed-noncanonical-and-corrupt-input
pending: Publish one-past vectors for every count/length bound and every prohibited non-canonical scalar form.

entries.name: total-and-directional-budget-boundaries
entries.result: Exact-fit records are admitted and one-byte-over records are rejected without counter mutation in both directions.

entries.name: negotiation-and-extension-compatibility
pending: Publish stale-cache recovery and one vector for every incompatibility failure code.

entries.name: storage-failure-boundaries
entries.result: All nine named full-width durable boundaries are fault-injected and recover without false commit or lost recoverable prefix.

entries.name: failure-code-state-effects
pending: The specification enumerates failure codes but does not normatively map every code to retryable/non-retryable state transitions; expected traces are not invented here.

proposed_specification_questions.question: For V04, must a BEMPIC implementation normalize non-NFC application metadata itself, or may it reject non-NFC input and require the application preparation boundary to normalize first?
For V08, is mandatory coverage the Cartesian product of all prefix percentages, sender/receiver restart modes, and durable storage boundaries, or is independent coverage of each dimension sufficient?
For V10, what exact retransmission and receipt-state trace is normative when the final positive receipt is lost after the receiver has durably recorded commit?
For V15, which failure codes are normatively retryable, and what sender, collection, and representation state must each code preserve or reset?
Should a mandatory vector bundle publish semantic/state vectors independently of a registered codec, while deferring byte-exact wire vectors until a codec ID and revision are allocated?
